```{r}
# ============================================================
# Small example for the thesis:
# ordinary regression vs time-varying regression vs shrinkage
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Simulate small dataset
# -----------------------------
T <- 80
x <- rnorm(T)

beta_true <- rep(1, T)
beta_true[31:50] <- seq(1, 3, length.out = 20)
beta_true[51:80] <- 3

sigma_eps <- 0.4
y <- beta_true * x + rnorm(T, 0, sigma_eps)

df <- data.frame(
  time = 1:T,
  x = x,
  y = y,
  beta_true = beta_true
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Ordinary regression
# -----------------------------
fit_static <- lm(y ~ x - 1, data = df)
beta_static <- coef(fit_static)[1]

cat("Static beta estimate:", beta_static, "\n")

# This gives ONE beta for all time.
# But true beta changes from 1 to 3.


# -----------------------------
# 3. Kalman filter for TVP model
# -----------------------------
# Model:
# y_t = x_t * beta_t + eps_t
# beta_t = beta_{t-1} + eta_t

kalman_tvp <- function(y, x, q, r, beta0 = 0, P0 = 10) {
  T <- length(y)
  
  beta_pred <- numeric(T)
  beta_filt <- numeric(T)
  P_pred <- numeric(T)
  P_filt <- numeric(T)
  
  beta_prev <- beta0
  P_prev <- P0
  
  for (t in 1:T) {
    
    # Prediction step
    beta_prior <- beta_prev
    P_prior <- P_prev + q[t]
    
    # Observation update
    S <- x[t]^2 * P_prior + r
    K <- P_prior * x[t] / S
    
    beta_post <- beta_prior + K * (y[t] - x[t] * beta_prior)
    P_post <- (1 - K * x[t]) * P_prior
    
    beta_pred[t] <- beta_prior
    beta_filt[t] <- beta_post
    P_pred[t] <- P_prior
    P_filt[t] <- P_post
    
    beta_prev <- beta_post
    P_prev <- P_post
  }
  
  data.frame(
    time = 1:T,
    beta_filt = beta_filt,
    lower = beta_filt - 1.96 * sqrt(P_filt),
    upper = beta_filt + 1.96 * sqrt(P_filt)
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 4. Constant-variance TVP
# -----------------------------
# Ordinary TVP assumes beta changes with same variance every time.

q_constant <- rep(0.02, T)
r <- sigma_eps^2

res_constant <- kalman_tvp(y, x, q_constant, r)


# -----------------------------
# 5. Dynamic shrinkage idea
# -----------------------------
# Dynamic shrinkage says:
# most of the time beta should barely move,
# but sometimes it should be allowed to jump.

q_dynamic <- rep(0.001, T)
q_dynamic[31:50] <- 0.15

res_dynamic <- kalman_tvp(y, x, q_dynamic, r)


# -----------------------------
# 6. Plot results
# -----------------------------
plot(
  df$time, df$beta_true,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 3,
  ylim = range(c(df$beta_true, res_constant$beta_filt, res_dynamic$beta_filt)),
  xlab = "Time",
  ylab = expression(beta[t]),
  main = "Time-varying coefficient"
)

lines(df$time, rep(beta_static, T), lwd = 2, lty = 2)
lines(res_constant$time, res_constant$beta_filt, lwd = 2)
lines(res_dynamic$time, res_dynamic$beta_filt, lwd = 2)

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c(
    "True beta",
    "Static regression",
    "TVP constant variance",
    "TVP dynamic shrinkage idea"
  ),
  lwd = c(3, 2, 2, 2),
  lty = c(1, 2, 1, 1),
  bty = "n"
)


# -----------------------------
# 7. Compare errors
# -----------------------------
mse_static <- mean((rep(beta_static, T) - beta_true)^2)
mse_constant <- mean((res_constant$beta_filt - beta_true)^2)
mse_dynamic <- mean((res_dynamic$beta_filt - beta_true)^2)

cat("\nMean squared error:\n")
cat("Static regression:       ", mse_static, "\n")
cat("TVP constant variance:   ", mse_constant, "\n")
cat("TVP dynamic shrinkage:   ", mse_dynamic, "\n")
```


```{r}
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)

# Parameters
mu_x <- 0
mu_y <- 0

sigma_x <- 1
sigma_y <- 1.5

rho <- 0.7

# Covariance matrix
Sigma <- matrix(c(
  sigma_x^2,
  rho * sigma_x * sigma_y,
  rho * sigma_x * sigma_y,
  sigma_y^2
), nrow = 2)

# Generate data
set.seed(123)

n <- 5000

data <- as.data.frame(
  mvrnorm(
    n = n,
    mu = c(mu_x, mu_y),
    Sigma = Sigma
  )
)

colnames(data) <- c("X", "Y")

# -------------------------------------------------
# Conditional distribution Y | X = x0
# -------------------------------------------------

x0 <- 1

cond_mean <- mu_y +
  rho * sigma_y / sigma_x * (x0 - mu_x)

cond_sd <- sqrt(
  sigma_y^2 * (1 - rho^2)
)

# Density grid
y_grid <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 500)

cond_density <- dnorm(
  y_grid,
  mean = cond_mean,
  sd = cond_sd
)

cond_df <- data.frame(
  Y = y_grid,
  Density = cond_density
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Plot 1: Joint distribution
# -------------------------------------------------

p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(X, Y)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = x0,
             color = "red",
             linewidth = 1) +
  ggtitle("Joint Distribution of X and Y")

print(p1)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Plot 2: Conditional density
# -------------------------------------------------

p2 <- ggplot(cond_df, aes(Y, Density)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  ggtitle(
    paste0(
      "Conditional Distribution: Y | X = ",
      x0
    )
  )

print(p2)
```

```{r}
library(mvtnorm)
library(plotly)

# Parameters
mu <- c(0, 0)

sigma_x <- 1
sigma_y <- 1.5
rho <- 0.7

Sigma <- matrix(c(
  sigma_x^2, rho * sigma_x * sigma_y,
  rho * sigma_x * sigma_y, sigma_y^2
), nrow = 2)

# Grid
x <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 100)
y <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)

grid <- expand.grid(X = x, Y = y)

# Joint density f(X, Y)
z <- matrix(
  dmvnorm(grid, mean = mu, sigma = Sigma),
  nrow = length(x),
  ncol = length(y)
)

# Conditional slice X = x0
x0 <- 1

cond_mean <- mu[2] + rho * sigma_y / sigma_x * (x0 - mu[1])
cond_sd <- sqrt(sigma_y^2 * (1 - rho^2))

y_slice <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 200)

# Joint density along X = x0
z_slice <- dmvnorm(
  cbind(x0, y_slice),
  mean = mu,
  sigma = Sigma
)

tail(sort(z_slice))


plot_ly() %>%
  add_surface(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    z = z,
    opacity = 0.85
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    x = rep(x0, length(y_slice)),
    y = y_slice,
    z = z_slice,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = "red", width = 8),
    name = paste0("Slice: X = ", x0)
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "3D Joint Normal Density with Conditional Slice",
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "X"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Y"),
      zaxis = list(title = "Density")
    )
  )
```

## joint distribution
```{r}
library(mvtnorm)
library(plotly)

# =====================================================
# Parameters
# =====================================================

mu <- c(0, 0)

sigma_x <- 1
sigma_y <- 1.5
rho <- 0.7

Sigma <- matrix(
  c(
    sigma_x^2,
    rho * sigma_x * sigma_y,

    rho * sigma_x * sigma_y,
    sigma_y^2
  ),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)

# =====================================================
# Grid for joint density
# =====================================================

x <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 100)
y <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)

grid <- expand.grid(
  X = x,
  Y = y
)

# Joint density values
z <- matrix(
  dmvnorm(
    grid,
    mean = mu,
    sigma = Sigma
  ),
  nrow = length(x),
  ncol = length(y)
)

# =====================================================
# Slice at fixed X = x0
# =====================================================

x0 <- 1

y_slice <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 300)

z_slice <- dmvnorm(
  cbind(
    rep(x0, length(y_slice)),
    y_slice
  ),
  mean = mu,
  sigma = Sigma
)

tail(sort(z_slice))
sum(z_slice*(y_slice[2]- y_slice[1]))
dnorm(1)
# =====================================================
# 3D plot
# =====================================================

plot_ly() %>%

  # Joint distribution surface
  add_surface(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    z = z,
    opacity = 0.85,
    colorscale = "Viridis",
    name = "Joint Density"
  ) %>%

  # Slice from joint density
  add_trace(
    x = rep(x0, length(y_slice)),
    y = y_slice,
    z = z_slice,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(
      color = "red",
      width = 10
    ),
    name = paste0("Slice at X = ", x0)
  ) %>%

  layout(
    title = "Joint Distribution with Density Slice",
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "X"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Y"),
      zaxis = list(title = "Density")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
library(plotly)

# =====================================================
# Parameters
# =====================================================

mu_x <- 0
mu_y <- 0

sigma_x <- 1
sigma_y <- 1.5
rho <- 0.7

# =====================================================
# Conditional distribution: Y | X = x
# =====================================================

x <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 100)
y <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)

grid <- expand.grid(X = x, Y = y)

cond_mean <- mu_y + rho * sigma_y / sigma_x * (grid$X - mu_x)
cond_sd <- sqrt(sigma_y^2 * (1 - rho^2))

z <- matrix(
  dnorm(
    grid$Y,
    mean = cond_mean,
    sd = cond_sd
  ),
  nrow = length(x),
  ncol = length(y)
)

# =====================================================
# Slice at fixed X = x0
# =====================================================

x0 <- 1

y_slice <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 300)

cond_mean_x0 <- mu_y + rho * sigma_y / sigma_x * (x0 - mu_x)
cond_sd_x0 <- sqrt(sigma_y^2 * (1 - rho^2))

z_slice <- dnorm(
  y_slice,
  mean = cond_mean_x0,
  sd = cond_sd_x0
)
sum(z_slice*(y_slice[2]- y_slice[1]))

# =====================================================
# 3D plot
# =====================================================

plot_ly() %>%
  add_surface(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    z = z,
    opacity = 0.85,
    colorscale = "Viridis",
    name = "Conditional Density"
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    x = rep(x0, length(y_slice)),
    y = y_slice,
    z = z_slice,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = "red", width = 10),
    name = paste0("Y | X = ", x0)
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Conditional Distribution Surface: Y | X",
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "Fixed X value"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Y"),
      zaxis = list(title = "Conditional Density")
    )
  )
```
